# Synthetic fixture images

Every file here is **SYNTHETIC**: a solid-colour image generated by `generate.ts` (`pnpm exec tsx tests/fixtures/images/generate.ts`). None is a product photo, and none is ever shown in live mode. They exist so CI never fetches an image from the internet (`FixtureImageFetch`, EV-014, EV-015).

| File | Type | Size | Rule I3 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ok-400x300.jpg` | JPEG (grey) | 400x300 | ok |
| `ok-400x300.png` | PNG | 400x300 | ok |
| `ok-400x300.webp` | WebP (lossless) | 400x300 | ok |
| `ok-400x300.avif` | AVIF container with an `ispe` box and no coded image | 400x300 | ok (sniffed only; a browser cannot decode it) |
| `fail-1x1.gif` | GIF | 1x1 | unsupported-type |
| `fail-doc.svg` | SVG document | n/a | unsupported-type |
| `fail-150x400.png` | PNG | 150x400 | too-small |
| `fail-1200x630.webp` | WebP (lossless) | 1200x630 | aspect |
